title: FailureSpot: Label-Efficient Timestamp-Level Failure Detection for Vision-Language-Action Models
description:
arXiv:2609.04277v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but they can still fail unpredictably during long-horizon execution, making reliable failure detection essential for safe deployment. Existing methods either rely on visual models that typically detect failures only after erroneous actions have occurred, or use lightweight proactive detectors trained on VLA internal representations.
